current.text: Rookie. The Hawks picked him 23rd in the 2026 NBA draft.
He is a backup. Onyeka Okongwu is the projected starting center and Jock Landale is in the bench rotation.
Lloyd expects a 10-man rotation and does not name him in it. The bench he lists is Dort, Wiggins, Landale, Flemings and probably Newell, with Kispert and Finney-Smith also in the mix.
Atlanta's big man depth is thin. Veesaar is out for the season, Gueye is injured, and power forward depth is bad to start the season.

durable.text: He put up big numbers at St. John's as an upperclassman. Experts see that as a red flag and say the numbers may not translate.
In Summer League he took 52% of his shots from three and made 35%, after barely shooting threes in college.
Projections make him clearly weak in points, steals and threes compared with the pool.

note: He is not a draft target in a 144-player auction. Yahoo values him at 0 USD and ranks him 724th, ESPN has no price, and his projection of 5.0 points with almost no threes or steals gives a team little to use. Watch him early on waivers only if Atlanta's thin big man depth (Veesaar out, Gueye hurt) gives him minutes, and check whether his Summer League three-point volume carries over in Snyder's five-out offense.
